name: Amazon
notes: Only on amazon.de: Mein Konto (My account) > Anmelden & Sicherheit (Login & security) > E-Mail > Bearbeiten (Edit). A link is sent to the new address. amazon.de's own help page blocks automated reading; source is the Amazon Pay help page.

name: eBay
notes: Mein eBay (My eBay) > eBay-Konto (eBay account) > Persönliche Daten (Personal data) > Bearbeiten (Edit). Web.

name: Kleinanzeigen
notes: Meins (My Kleinanzeigen) > Einstellungen (Settings). Desktop website only, not in the app or mobile site. Confirm via link sent to the new address.

name: Zalando
notes: Found by hand on Zalando Lounge (Poland): My account > Personal details. The zalando.de help link did not lead there. The zalando.de page is likely similar but not checked.

name: OTTO
notes: FAQ says personal data is changed under Mein Konto (My account) > Meine persönlichen Daten (My personal data); the email is confirmed there. The FAQ does not describe the email change step by step.

name: Lieferando
notes: No self-service option: contact Lieferando customer service and ask for the change, from your current account email if possible, giving old and new address. Newsletter settings are separate under My details (https://www.lieferando.de/en/myaccount/my-details). Source: a web search summary, not yet confirmed on a Lieferando help article.

name: PayPal
notes: Einstellungen (Settings) > E-Mail-Adresse > Bearbeiten (Edit), web or app. The main address can't be edited directly: add the new address, confirm it via link, make it primary, then remove the old one.

name: ING Deutschland
notes: Contact email. Online banking: Meine Konten (My accounts) > Einstellungen (Settings) > Mein Profil (My profile). App: Service > Persönliche Daten (Personal data). Changes are released in the app.

name: DKB
notes: Contact email. Web banking or app: Profil > Mein Profil (My profile) > Kontaktdaten ändern (Change contact data), then confirm.

name: N26
notes: Email can only be changed via the in-app chat with N26 support, after identity checks. Not by email.

name: Commerzbank
notes: Banking app only: Service > Kontaktdaten ändern (Change contact data). Confirm with photoTAN.

name: Deutsche Telekom
notes: Contact email (contracts and bills). Kundencenter: Mein Profil (My profile) > Kontaktdaten (Contact data) > E-Mail-Adresse > Weiter. App MeinMagenta: user icon > Persönliche Daten (Personal data) > E-Mail-Adresse. Enter the new address and the code sent to it. Alternative: contact form. (Renaming a Telekom mailbox @t-online.de is a different thing, done in E-Mail Center.)

name: Vodafone
notes: Login email: changeable in MeinVodafone, per a customer in the Vodafone community. The separate contact email reportedly can NOT be changed online any more (customer, after several WhatsApp chats with Vodafone staff). No official help article found.

name: O2
notes: Contact email, in Mein O2 > Meine Daten (My data). Direct link given by O2 staff in the community. Log in with your phone number; confirm via link sent to the new address.

name: Techniker Krankenkasse
notes: Meine TK portal page for changing the email; asks for login (insurance number and password) first.

name: HUK-COBURG
notes: Meine HUK: email for a contract via Vertragsübersicht (Contract overview) > contract > Anzeigen (Show). Changing login data needs an unlock (Freischaltung) and a 'super password'.

name: Allianz
notes: Meine Allianz > Meine Daten (My data). Security changes confirmed with an SMS code. Without a Meine Allianz account: online form with contract number (https://www.allianz.de/service/kontaktdaten/).

name: ELSTER (tax portal)
notes: Help page (Benutzerangaben > E-Mail-Adresse) says the change is done once you click the confirmation link sent to the new address; it does not show where to start it. Login needs the certificate file. Users in the ELSTER forum report confusion.

name: BundID
notes: The official BundID FAQ (https://id.bund.de/de/faq) has no answer on changing the email. Ask via the contact form there.

name: Deutsche Bahn
notes: bahn.de: Kundenkonto verwalten (Manage customer account) > Login & Sicherheit (Login & security) > E-Mail ändern (Change email). App: DB Navigator > Profil.

name: Booking.com
notes: Booking.com's help centre only opens after signing in or entering a booking number, so no public instructions. Customer service: customer.service.help@booking.com.

name: Microsoft account
notes: 'Manage how you sign in': add the new address as an alias, verify it, make it primary, then remove the old one.

name: Apple Account
notes: iPhone: Settings > [your name] > Sign-In & Security > primary email. Web: account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > Email & Phone Numbers. Verify the new address.

name: Netflix
notes: Direct 'Change Email' page. May ask you to confirm your identity.

name: PAYBACK
notes: Mein PAYBACK > Meine Zugangsdaten (My access data) > E-Mail-Adresse, Passwort oder PIN ändern (Change email, password or PIN).
